title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents
summary: The briefing's rollout, administrator installation requirement, licensing and control references are supported. Microsoft pages disagree about authentication-field naming, connection limits and editing, and billing units; the briefing should disclose those discrepancies.

claims.claim: Microsoft is introducing Agent2Agent-enabled Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents.
claims.quote: Microsoft is introducing support for Microsoft Agent 365 agents that implement the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, allowing them to be used as connected agents in declarative agents built with Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit.

claims.claim: The roadmap title describes using Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and declarative agents.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Declarative Agents

claims.claim: The notice says A2A support sits alongside existing OpenAPI and MCP server connections.
claims.quote: In addition to existing support for OpenAPI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, declarative agents can now connect to Agent2Agent-enabled agents

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Developers declare connections in the declarative agent manifest's worker_agents property.
claims.quote: You declare these connections in the agent manifest by listing agent title IDs in the worker_agents property.

claims.claim: The identifiers listed in worker_agents are the connected agents' title IDs.
claims.quote: Add the title ID to the worker_agents property as the id.

claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot evaluates the connected agents declared in the manifest and selects one based on the current task and the connected agent's name, description, and example prompts.

claims.claim: Copilot sends a text request to the selected connected agent.
claims.quote: Copilot sends a text request to the selected connected agent

claims.claim: Copilot receives the connected agent's response and incorporates it into the user's ongoing interaction.
claims.quote: receives a text response, and incorporates that response into the declarative agent's ongoing interaction with the user.

claims.claim: Connected agents must be registered in the Microsoft Agent 365 agent registry.
claims.quote: You must register connected agents in the Microsoft Agent 365 agent registry.

claims.claim: An A2A connected agent needs a registered Agent2Agent agent card.
claims.quote: The other agent must be a declarative agent or have a registered Agent2Agent agent card.

claims.quote: Searched: Agent2Agent connected agents Agent Builder Copilot Studio support connected agents approval Connected Agents tab. Read the roadmap, MC1478975, declarative-agent-connected-agent and manage-connected-agents; Studio results describe a different integration.

claims.claim: An external A2A agent declares authentication through an authorization object referencing an authentication registration.
claims.quote: the registration references an existing authentication registration through the authorization object in the agentRegistration.
claims.fix: Add: 'The connection guide calls this object authorization, while the Agent Registration API resource reference names the property a2aAuthorization.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/api/admin-settings/agent-registration/resources/agentregistration, which describes a2aAuthorization as 'Authorization configuration used to invoke an Agent2Agent server.'

claims.quote: In the Review permissions pane, review the requested permissions for the agent. If the permissions are acceptable, select Grant admin consent.

claims.claim: Users do not need to choose the connected agent themselves.
claims.quote: users see the agent-to-agent exchange but don't need to select connected agents themselves.

claims.claim: An agent can connect to up to 10 other agents.
claims.quote: Limit - An agent can connect to up to 10 other agents.
claims.fix: Add: 'The agent-details page instead describes the limit as 10 connections excluding those added by the agent maker.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-agent-365/admin/agent-details#connected-agents, which says 'You can connect up to 10 agents to the selected agent, excluding those added by the agent's maker.'

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: For agents other than Researcher and Sales, administrators can view developer-configured connections but cannot add or remove them.

Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-agent-365/admin/agent-details#connected-agents.
